tool_schemas.name: interactive_feedback
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new interactive feedback request for the given project_directory and one-line summary, snapshots basic project metadata, and returns the created request record (including its generated identifier and initial state). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_directory or summary is missing/empty or otherwise fails input validation, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to create feedback requests for that project. Raises CONFLICT if there is already an open feedback request for the same project_directory and summary (or other uniqueness constraint is violated), and raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the caller has reached a service limit for active requests.

project_directory.description: Full path to the project directory
project_directory.title: Project Directory

summary.description: Short, one-line summary of the changes
summary.title: Summary

tool_schemas.name: interactive_feedback_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if no valid credentials are provided.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

tool_schemas.name: interactive_feedback_requests_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists feedback requests visible to the caller, optionally filtered by project_id, project_directory, status, or client_request_id, ordered by created_at descending. Returns a paginated page of feedback request records; refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list requests.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

project_id.description: Filter to feedback requests for the given project id.

project_directory.description: Filter by the verbatim project_directory stored on the request.

client_request_id.description: Filter by a client-supplied id for idempotency/correlation.

created_after.description: Only return requests created after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_before.description: Only return requests created before this timestamp (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: interactive_feedback_request_get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single feedback request by id. Returns the request record if found; refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

tool_schemas.name: interactive_feedback_request_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates a feedback request and/or drives its lifecycle status transitions (queued→active/cancelled/errored, active→awaiting_user/completed/cancelled/errored, awaiting_user→active/completed/cancelled/errored). Returns the updated request record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for illegal transitions or invalid fields (including completing with unanswered required prompts), and sets closed_at when transitioning to completed/cancelled/errored.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

status.description: New status for the request; must be a valid lifecycle transition from the current status.

error_message.description: Error message to store when transitioning to errored. Ignored unless status=errored.

opened_at.description: Timestamp when the request was opened/activated (server may overwrite on activation).

closed_at.description: Timestamp when the request was closed (server sets on completed/cancelled/errored).

tool_schemas.name: interactive_feedback_request_prompts_upsert
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates the set of prompts for a feedback request. Prompts are keyed by sequence_no (starting at 1, unique per request). Returns the upserted prompt records. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if sequence numbers are invalid/duplicated, prompt fields are invalid, or if the request is completed/cancelled/errored.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

prompts.description: Prompts to create or update for the request (upsert by sequence_no).

sequence_no.description: 1-based sequence number for ordering within the request.

title.description: Short title shown to the user.

body.description: Prompt body shown to the user.

choices.description: Choices for single_choice/multi_choice prompts; must be omitted or empty for other prompt types.

is_required.description: Whether the prompt must be answered before completing the request.

status.description: Optional prompt status transition (pending→presented/skipped, presented→answered/skipped). If provided, must be valid from the current status.

tool_schemas.name: interactive_feedback_response_record
tool_schemas.description: Records a user's response for a prompt (one response per prompt). Creates a feedback_responses row and updates the prompt status to answered. Returns the created response record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if the prompt already has a response, if the response payload does not match the prompt_type/response_type, or if the request/prompt is not in a state that can accept responses.

auth_token.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the caller.

response_type.description: Type of response payload being recorded.

response_text.description: Free-form text response; required when response_type=text.

selected_choices.description: Selected choice values; required when response_type=single_choice or multi_choice.

responded_at.description: Client timestamp when the user responded; server sets if omitted.

metadata.name: Interactive Feedback
metadata.description: This backend stores interactive feedback requests tied to a local project directory and a one-line change summary. The main workflow is: create a feedback request, snapshot basic project metadata, generate one or more questions/prompts for the user, and record user responses to close out the request
